courses.title: Machine Learning
searches: Middlebury College CSCI 0316 OR 0451 OR "Artificial Intelligence" OR "Machine Learning" course syllabus 2026
Middlebury "CSCI 0414" OR "CSCI 0311" syllabus "AI policy" OR ChatGPT
courses.note: Elective: the major requires no AI or ML course. CSCI 0451 was offered in two sections in Spring 2026 (Course Hub listing); CSCI 0311 AI also runs regularly. Only course-hub group pages (description, no syllabus) are public; syllabi sit behind the Course Hub login.

courses.title: Advanced Operating Systems
searches: Middlebury College "Advanced Operating Systems" CSCI 0414 syllabus
Middlebury "CSCI 0414" OR "CSCI 0311" syllabus "AI policy" OR ChatGPT
courses.note: Elective: no operating systems or security course is required. CSCI 0414 is the upper-level OS elective (listed for Spring 2027 on the Course Hub); it is distinct from C3 (CSCI 0302). Only course-hub group pages without syllabi are public; syllabi sit behind the Course Hub login.

notes: Requirements page lists CSCI 0145 or 0146 or 0150, 0200, 0201, 0202, 0301, 0302, four electives and one Responsible Computing course. The department's course syllabi sit on the Course Hub behind a login. Middlebury also publishes college-wide generative AI syllabus statement options for instructors (middlebury.edu/ai/guidance-and-resources/faculty); those are institution-layer documents, not course syllabi, and were not collected here.
